item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q004_ferritin_like_functional_divergence","answer":"In the current SCOPe base release 2.08 (latest periodic-update label 2.08-2026-08-16), all three groups are in the all-alpha class a, Ferritin-like fold a.25 (SUNID 47239), and Ferritin-like superfamily a.25.1 (SUNID 47240). SCOPe explicitly marks homology as implied at this superfamily level, supporting remote common ancestry and divergence of a conserved helical metal-binding scaffold. They are nevertheless separate families: Ferritin a.25.1.1 (SUNID 47241), Ribonucleotide reductase-like a.25.1.2 (SUNID 47253), and Manganese catalase/T-catalase a.25.1.3 (SUNID 100951). Their different chemistries are therefore functional divergence, not a contradiction: canonical ferritins oxidize and store iron, RNR R2-like proteins use a metal/oxygen center in radical-generating chemistry, and manganese catalases disproportionate peroxide at a manganese center. Class or fold membership alone would be weak evidence of ancestry; here the stronger statement comes from their shared SCOPe superfamily. Conversely, superfamily homology does not justify transferring substrate specificity, metal preference, catalytic mechanism, active-site residues, oligomeric state, or exact function among the three families. Cross-family templates may support fold recognition and modeling of the conserved core, but active-site geometry, insertions, termini, and assemblies require family-specific evidence. Prefer same-family templates with appropriate domain boundaries, sequence coverage, structural quality, biological assembly, and metal/cofactor state; an ASTRAL/SCOPe representative is a redundancy representative, not necessarily a functional archetype. Functional assignment should additionally require sequence-profile and residue-level conservation, local metal-site/cofactor evidence, and preferably curated biochemical assays, metal analysis/spectroscopy, or other experimental annotation.","evidence_used":["pretrained model knowledge","/api/v1/","/api/v1/openapi.yaml","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ferritin&limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ribonucleotide+reductase&limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=manganese+catalase&limit=100","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ferritin&limit=10","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ribonucleotide+reductase&limit=10","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=manganese+catalase&limit=10","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=ribonucleotide&limit=25","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.25","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.25.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.25.1.1","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.25.1.2","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sccs/a.25.1.3","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47239","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47240","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47241","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47253","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/100951","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47240/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/47240/children?limit=100"]}]}
